text:
ARCHIDAMUS:
  Camillo, if you ever happen to visit Bohemia on business like the business that brings me here,
  you'll see, as I've said, a great difference between our Bohemia and your Sicilia.
CAMILLO:
  I think the King of Sicilia means to visit Bohemia this coming summer.
  He rightly owes your king that visit.
ARCHIDAMUS:
  And when he comes, our hospitality will put us to shame.
  Our affection will have to make up for it. Because honestly—
CAMILLO:
  Please, don't—
